question: What are the "Golden Rules" listed on page 1 regarding file management and conversation length when working with AI coding assistants?
expected_facts: Use markdown files to manage the project: README.md, PLANNING.md, TASK.md
Keep files under 500 lines; split into modules when needed
Start fresh conversations often, since long threads degrade response quality

evidence.source_evidence: PDF viewer page 1 — "1. 🔑 Golden Rules / These are the high-level principles that guide how to work with AI tools efficiently and effectively... Be specific in your requests... Write docs and comments as you go... Implement environment variables yourself. Don't trust the LLM with API keys."
